submitted.rationale: Index 3 (Sb 0.353) gave the highest measured EQE, 0.0688%. The other results were: idx1 0.0447%, idx8 0.0235%, idx20 0.0014%, idx13 0.0010%. EQE drops on both sides of idx 3, so the peak is probably near 0.35–0.40 Sb. XRD shows the same Pb-rich pyrochlore-like phase at idx 0, 1 and 3, with the lattice shrinking as Sb increases. At idx 6 (0.44) there is a new weak secondary peak (Q≈3.23) and stronger Pt substrate peaks. That puts the best single-phase composition at the Sb-rich edge of the pure-phase region.
